parsed.justification: Rationale A mischaracterizes the comment as a 'clarification question' when it is actually an explicit suggestion for further work. It also assigns a score of 2, but the comment does contain an explicit action ('investigate whether...'), which better aligns with score 3 per the rubric. The evidence grounding is weaker because it incorrectly categorizes the comment type. Rationale B correctly identifies the comment as containing an explicit action (investigate ghost sentences persisting after LLM rewriting), recognizes the lack of concrete implementation details, and accurately maps this to score 3 on the rubric. Its claims are well-supported by the text and it avoids unsupported assumptions.
